"""Probe harness (scratch, not committed): builds texts, projects and runs the check and the filter of this worktree."""
import hashlib, itertools, json, os, re, shutil, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
WT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-69")
sys.path.insert(0, str(WT / "src"))
import gov.secrets as S
import yaml

ALNUM = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
B64 = ALNUM + "+/"
SHELTERED = ("false", "true", "null", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
D5 = "-" * 5
PRIV = "PRIV" + "ATE KEY"

def chars(seed, n, alphabet=ALNUM):
    for attempt in itertools.count():
        out = []
        for count in itertools.count():
            for byte in hashlib.sha256(f"probe:{seed}:{attempt}:{count}".encode()).digest():
                out.append(alphabet[byte % len(alphabet)])
                if len(out) == n:
                    break
            if len(out) == n:
                break
        text = "".join(out)
        if not any(w in text.lower() for w in SHELTERED):
            return text

def body_lines(seed, total, width=64, lead=""):
    """base64 lines summing to about ``total`` characters (newlines not counted)."""
    lines, n = [], 0
    while n < total:
        w = min(width, total - n)
        line = chars(f"{seed}-{len(lines)}", w, B64)
        lines.append(line)
        n += w
    if lead:
        lines[0] = lead + lines[0][len(lead):]
    return lines

def words_paragraphs(seed, size, para=True):
    """Text of about ``size`` bytes: lines of 72 bytes of lower-case words; a blank line every six lines if ``para``."""
    out, n, i = [], 0, 0
    while n < size:
        words, length = [], 0
        while length < 71:
            w = chars(f"{seed}-w{i}-{len(words)}", 3 + (len(words) * 7 + i) % 6, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
            words.append(w)
            length += len(w) + 1
        line = " ".join(words)[:71].rstrip()
        line = line + " " * (71 - len(line))
        out.append(line + "\n")
        n += 72
        i += 1
        if para and i % 6 == 0:
            out.append("\n")
            n += 1
    return "".join(out)

def regular_pieces(chunk: bytes):
    saved = S._key_blocks
    S._key_blocks = lambda whole: iter(())
    try:
        return list(S._pieces(chunk))
    finally:
        S._key_blocks = saved

def piece_spans(chunk: bytes):
    """(start, end) in the form-fed chunk of each regular piece, recomputed as _pieces does."""
    c = S._BLANK.sub(rb"\1\f", chunk)
    spans, start = [], 0
    while len(c) - start > S._PIECE:
        end, edge = S._cut(c, start + 2 * S._OVERLAP, start + S._PIECE)
        spans.append((start, end))
        start, edge = S._cut(c, start + 1, end - S._OVERLAP)
    spans.append((start, len(c)))
    return c, spans

def whole_in_a_regular_piece(chunk: bytes, block: bytes) -> bool:
    c = S._BLANK.sub(rb"\1\f", chunk)
    fb = S._BLANK.sub(rb"\1\f", block)
    return any(fb in p for p in regular_pieces(chunk))

def path_map_text():
    doc = yaml.safe_load((WT / "template/governance/project/path-map.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    doc.setdefault("namespaces", {})["docs"] = {
        "paths": ["docs/**"], "memory_class": "governance", "sensitivity": "internal",
        "permitted_roles": ["engineer", "independent-test-designer", "independent-auditor", "orchestrator",
                            "product-spec", "research"],
        "retention": "kept in git history", "export_policy": "allowed", "embedding_policy": "embedded",
        "provenance": "probe", "deletion_rebuild": "authoritative; restored from git only"}
    return yaml.safe_dump(doc, sort_keys=False)

def project(path: Path, toml_text=None):
    if path.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(path)
    path.mkdir(parents=True)
    (path / ".gitleaks.toml").write_text(toml_text or (WT / "template/.gitleaks.toml").read_text())
    (path / "governance/project").mkdir(parents=True)
    (path / "governance/project/path-map.yaml").write_text(path_map_text())
    (path / ".gov-runtime").mkdir()
    (path / "docs").mkdir()
    return path

def gitleaks_direct(data: bytes, rules=None):
    """Exit code of one gitleaks stdin run per rule set on ``data`` as given (no pieces)."""
    rules = rules or S._rules(WT)
    codes = []
    for each in rules:
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "GITLEAKS_CONFIG"} | {"GITLEAKS_CONFIG_TOML": each}
        done = subprocess.run(["gitleaks", "stdin", "--no-banner", "--redact", "--ignore-gitleaks-allow",
                               "--gitleaks-ignore-path", "/dev/null", "--log-level", "error", "--exit-code", "3"],
                              input=data, capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=600)
        codes.append(done.returncode)
    return codes
EOF
